limitations: Contract schema_version is pack format version, not APK save version.
Static normal non-Test/non-Premium analysis; Premium/offer economy not reconstructed.
No first-install runtime profile, atomicity, save migration or cloud/durability proof.
Trial writers and expiry not reconstructed; never infer trial state only from unlock status.
Rank tables alone do not enforce caps or establish whole upgrade payment/transaction flow.
No roster validity inferred from broad ID comparisons; no invented validation or monotonic correction.
Gameplay cache refresh/switching lifecycle is partial; snapshots may outlive saved changes.
Tech/talent consumers are scoped examples, not full combat formula coverage.
